# POST /api/owners — Complete Validation & Side-Effect Trace

## 1. Endpoint mapping

The endpoint is **not** in the V2 controller (V2 only has `listOwnersPage`). It is handled by **`OwnerRestControllerV1.addOwner(...)`**.

- Mapping is inherited from the generated interface `OwnersApi` (OpenAPI-generated):
  `/home/daniel/sandbox/target/generated-sources/openapi/.../rest/api/OwnersApi.java:79-87`
  ```java
  @RequestMapping(method = RequestMethod.POST, value = "/owners",   // PATH_ADD_OWNER
      produces = {"application/json"}, consumes = {"application/json"})
  default ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(
      @Parameter(...required = true) @Valid @RequestBody OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto) { ... }
  ```
  Combined with the controller's class-level `@RequestMapping("/api")`, the full path is **POST /api/owners**.
- The interface is annotated `@Validated` (class level, line 44) and the body parameter is `@Valid @RequestBody` (line 86) — this is what triggers Bean Validation on the DTO **before** the controller body runs.

## 2. Controller method (full source)

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/rest/controller/v1/OwnerRestControllerV1.java:169-202`

```java
@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")
@Override
public ResponseEntity<OwnerDto> addOwner(OwnerFieldsDto ownerFieldsDto) {
    validateRequiredOwnerFields(ownerFieldsDto);
    rejectFutureRegistrationDate(ownerFieldsDto.getRegistrationDate());
    LocalDate suppliedOrDefaultDate =
        ownerFieldsDto.getRegistrationDate() != null ? ownerFieldsDto.getRegistrationDate() : LocalDate.now();
    LocalDate registrationDate = toBusinessDay(suppliedOrDefaultDate);
    rejectDailyLimitExceeded(registrationDate);
    rejectCityAtCapacity(ownerFieldsDto.getCity());
    HttpHeaders headers = new HttpHeaders();
    Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto);
    validatePostcode(owner.getCity(), owner.getPostcode());
    owner.setAddress(normalizeAddress(owner.getAddress()));
    String normalizedTelephone = normalizeTelephone(owner.getTelephone());
    owner.setTelephone(normalizedTelephone);
    boolean declaredHouseholdMember = applyHousehold(owner, ownerFieldsDto.getSharesHousehold());
    owner.setEmail(normalizeEmail(owner.getEmail()));
    rejectDuplicateIdentity(owner);
    applyPossibleDuplicate(owner, declaredHouseholdMember);
    owner.setRegistrationDate(registrationDate);
    owner.setCustomerCode(
        generateCustomerCode(owner.getPostcode(), owner.getCity(), normalizedTelephone, owner.getLastName()));
    owner.setMembershipNumber(generateMembershipNumber(owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate()));
    owner.setNamesakeCount(countNamesakes(owner.getFirstName(), owner.getLastName()));
    this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);
    AUDIT.info("Owner created: id={} customerCode={} registrationDate={} membershipLevel={}",
        owner.getId(), owner.getCustomerCode(), owner.getRegistrationDate(), owner.getMembershipLevel());
    OwnerDto ownerDto = toOwnerDto(owner);
    ownerDto.setBulkSignupWarning(isBulkSignupWarningActive());
    headers.setLocation(UriComponentsBuilder.newInstance()
        .path("/api/owners/{id}").buildAndExpand(owner.getId()).toUri());
    return new ResponseEntity<>(ownerDto, headers, HttpStatus.CREATED);
}
```

## 3. Service layer

`saveOwner` is a thin facade — the only persistence call. `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java:232-237`
```java
@Override
@Transactional
public void saveOwner(Owner owner) throws DataAccessException {
    ownerRepository.save(owner);
}
```
The class is `@Service`; `saveOwner` opens a write transaction. The controller also calls read-only service methods (`findAllOwners()`) many times through its private helpers.

Repository (JPA impl) `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java:92-100` — new-vs-existing branch:
```java
public void save(Owner owner) {
    if (owner.getId() == null) { this.em.persist(owner); }   // create path (id null after map)
    else { this.em.merge(owner); }
}
```
(There is also a JDBC impl `JdbcOwnerRepositoryImpl.save`; which is active depends on profile.)

## 4. Bean Validation annotations

**Two layers of Bean Validation constraints exist**, but only the DTO layer is actively enforced on this request (via `@Valid`). The entity constraints are declared but never explicitly re-validated in this flow (no `@Valid` at persist and mapper produces the entity directly).

### DTO: `OwnerFieldsDto` (the validated request body)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/target/generated-sources/openapi/.../rest/dto/OwnerFieldsDto.java` — constraints on getters:
- `firstName` (L76): `@NotNull` `@Pattern(regexp="^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$")` `@Size(min=1,max=30)`
- `lastName` (L97): `@NotNull` `@Pattern(regexp="^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$")` `@Size(min=1,max=30)`
- `address` (L118): `@NotNull` `@Size(min=1,max=255)`
- `city` (L139): `@NotNull` `@Size(min=1,max=80)`
- `telephone` (L160): `@NotNull` `@Size(min=1,max=20)`
- `email` (L181): `@Size(min=1,max=255)` (optional)
- `postcode` (L202): `@Pattern(regexp="^[0-9]{4}$")` (optional)
- `registrationDate` (L223): `@Valid` (nested, LocalDate)
- `birthDate` (L244): `@Valid` (nested)
- `sharesHousehold` (L256): no constraint

### Entity: `Owner` and its `Person` superclass (declared, JPA-persisted)
`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`:
- `address` (L39): `@NotEmpty`
- `city` (L43): `@NotEmpty`
- `telephone` (L47-48): `@NotEmpty` `@Pattern(regexp="^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$", message="Telephone must be in E.164 format")`
- `email`, `postcode`, `registrationDate`, `birthDate`, and all derived/generated fields: no constraints
- `pets` (L89): `@OneToMany(cascade = CascadeType.ALL, mappedBy="owner", fetch=EAGER)` — cascade persist, but no pets are attached during create

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Person.java`:
- `firstName` (L32): `@NotEmpty`
- `lastName` (L36): `@NotEmpty`

## 5. @Valid / @Validated / custom validators / @InitBinder / groups
- `@Validated` on interface `OwnersApi` (class level) + `@Valid @RequestBody` on the `ownerFieldsDto` param → standard bean validation of the DTO before controller body.
- **No `@InitBinder`** anywhere in `src/main/java`.
- **No validation groups** used.
- The only custom `ConstraintValidator` in the project is `PetAgeValidation` / `PetAgeValidator` (`rest/validation/`), which applies to **Pet**, not Owner — not part of this flow.
- The `@Valid` on `registrationDate`/`birthDate` in the DTO is cascade markers on `LocalDate`, effectively no-ops.

## 6. Manual validation / business rules (all in the controller, throwing exceptions)
All are private helpers in `OwnerRestControllerV1`; each throws a custom exception (mapped to HTTP statuses via advice classes in `rest/advice/`):
1. `validateRequiredOwnerFields` (L305) → `MissingOwnerFieldsException` if firstName/lastName/address(normalized)/city/telephone blank.
2. `rejectFutureRegistrationDate` (L339) → `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(["registrationDate"])` if date is after today.
3. `rejectDailyLimitExceeded` (L385) → `OwnerDailyLimitExceededException` if ≥ 100 owners already on that business day.
4. `rejectCityAtCapacity` (L427) → `OwnerCityCapacityExceededException` if city already has ≥ 50 owners.
5. `validatePostcode` (L576) → `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(["postcode"])` if present-but-not-4-digits or out of region range (NSW 2000-2099, VIC 3000-3099, QLD 4000-4099).
6. `normalizeTelephone` / `validateNationalNumberLength` (L493, L522) → `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(["telephone"])` if not valid E.164 or wrong national length (+61→9, +1→10).
7. `applyHousehold` (L733) → `DuplicateOwnerHouseholdException` if the (lastName, postcode) household already exists and `sharesHousehold` is not true.
8. `normalizeEmail` (L548) → `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(["email"])` if malformed or on the disposable-domain blocklist (mailinator.com, tempmail.com, guerrillamail.com).
9. `rejectDuplicateIdentity` (L634) → `DuplicateOwnerIdentityException` if identity key `telephone|email|householdId` matches an existing owner.

Also protected by `@PreAuthorize("hasRole(@roles.OWNER_ADMIN)")` (authorization before any of the above).

## 7. Side-effects (mutations, derived values, persistence, logging)
- **Field normalization / mutation on the entity:**
  - `owner.setAddress(normalizeAddress(...))` — trim, collapse whitespace, uppercase, expand ST→STREET/RD→ROAD/AVE→AVENUE (L182).
  - `owner.setTelephone(normalizedTelephone)` — E.164 form (L184).
  - `owner.setEmail(normalizeEmail(...))` — lowercased, or null (L186).
- **Derived / generated values set before save:**
  - `applyHousehold` sets `householdId` (deterministic SHA-256 of lastName|postcode, 12 hex chars) when postcode present (L185/733).
  - `applyPossibleDuplicate` sets `possibleDuplicate` (and `possibleDuplicateOf` = lowest-id soft match) (L188/658).
  - `owner.setRegistrationDate(registrationDate)` — supplied-or-today, rolled forward off weekends to Monday (L176/189).
  - `owner.setCustomerCode(...)` — `<REGION>-<HASH8>` (region from postcode/city, SHA-256 of telephone+lastName) (L190).
  - `owner.setMembershipNumber(...)` — `<customerCode>-M<YY>` (L192).
  - `owner.setNamesakeCount(...)` — count of existing owners with same first+last name (L193).
- **Persistence:** `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` → `ownerRepository.save` → `em.persist` (new entity; `@Transactional`). `Owner.pets` has `CascadeType.ALL`, but no pets are set here so nothing cascades. `id` is assigned by persist (L194).
- **Audit logging:** dedicated `AUDIT` logger emits one INFO line per successful create with id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel (L195-196).
- **Response building (post-save, read-only side effects):**
  - `toOwnerDto(owner)` sets `householdMemberCount` (transient) then maps via MapStruct `OwnerMapper.toOwnerDto` — which computes `displayName`, `initials`, `locality` (L690/197).
  - `ownerDto.setBulkSignupWarning(isBulkSignupWarningActive())` — true when >80 owners today (L198).
  - `Location` header set to `/api/owners/{id}` (L199-200); returns **201 CREATED**.
- **No password encoding, no email sending, no event publishing, no roles set, no explicit timestamp/`@PrePersist`** exist in this flow (none present in the codebase for Owner).

## 8. Order of operations
1. **Security:** `@PreAuthorize` role check (`OWNER_ADMIN`).
2. **Request binding + Bean Validation** of `OwnerFieldsDto` (`@Valid` → `@NotNull/@Pattern/@Size` on DTO). On failure → 400 before the method body.
3. **Controller body, in source order:**
   a. `validateRequiredOwnerFields` (required non-blank fields, using normalized address).
   b. `rejectFutureRegistrationDate`.
   c. compute effective date → `toBusinessDay` (weekend roll-forward).
   d. `rejectDailyLimitExceeded` (per-day quota).
   e. `rejectCityAtCapacity` (per-city quota).
   f. **map DTO → Owner** (`ownerMapper.toOwner`, id & pets ignored → id null).
   g. `validatePostcode`.
   h. normalize address → set.
   i. normalize telephone (+validate) → set.
   j. `applyHousehold` (sets householdId, may throw duplicate-household).
   k. normalize email → set.
   l. `rejectDuplicateIdentity` (hard duplicate).
   m. `applyPossibleDuplicate` (soft duplicate flags).
   n. set registrationDate, customerCode, membershipNumber, namesakeCount.
   o. **`saveOwner` → repository persist** (transaction commit).
   p. **AUDIT log**.
   q. build DTO (household count, mapper-derived fields), set bulkSignupWarning, set Location header.
   r. return **201 CREATED**.

Note: entity-level constraints (`@NotEmpty`, `Owner.telephone` `@Pattern`) are declared but not explicitly enforced in this path — validation is effectively done by the DTO constraints plus the manual controller checks. No files were modified.

9. `validatePostcode` → `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(["postcode"])` if postcode present but not 4 digits or outside allowed region ranges (NSW 2000–2099, VIC 3000–3099, QLD 4000–4099).
10. `normalizeTelephone` / `validateNationalNumberLength` → `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(["telephone"])` if not valid E.164 or wrong national length (+61 → 9 digits, +1 → 10).
11. `applyHousehold` → `DuplicateOwnerHouseholdException` if the (lastName, postcode) household already exists and `sharesHousehold` is not `true`.
12. `normalizeEmail` → `InvalidOwnerFieldsException(["email"])` if malformed or on the disposable-domain blocklist (mailinator.com, tempmail.com, guerrillamail.com).
13. `rejectDuplicateIdentity` → `DuplicateOwnerIdentityException` if identity key `telephone|email|householdId` matches an existing owner.

## Side-effects (in execution order)

14. **Effective registration date computed** — supplied date or `LocalDate.now()`, then `toBusinessDay` rolls weekends forward to Monday.
15. **DTO mapped to `Owner`** entity (`ownerMapper.toOwner`; id and pets not mapped, so id stays null → persist path).
16. **Address normalized & set** — trim, collapse whitespace, uppercase, expand ST→STREET/RD→ROAD/AVE→AVENUE.
17. **Telephone normalized & set** — canonical E.164 form.
18. **`householdId` set** (`applyHousehold`) — deterministic SHA-256 of `lastName|postcode` (12 hex chars) when postcode present.
19. **Email normalized & set** — lowercased, or null.
20. **`possibleDuplicate` / `possibleDuplicateOf` set** (`applyPossibleDuplicate`) — soft-match flags against lowest-id match.
21. **`registrationDate` set** to the computed business day.
22. **`customerCode` set** — `<REGION>-<HASH8>` (region from postcode/city, SHA-256 of telephone + lastName).
23. **`membershipNumber` set** — `<customerCode>-M<YY>`.
24. **`namesakeCount` set** — count of existing owners with the same first + last name.
25. **Persisted** — `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)` → `ownerRepository.save` → `em.persist` inside a `@Transactional` write; id assigned on commit.
26. **Audit log** — dedicated `AUDIT` logger emits one INFO line: id, customerCode, registrationDate, membershipLevel.
27. **Response DTO built** — `toOwnerDto` sets transient `householdMemberCount` and MapStruct derives `displayName`, `initials`, `locality`; `bulkSignupWarning` set (true when > 80 owners today).
28. **`Location` header** set to `/api/owners/{id}`; returns **201 CREATED**.

## Notes worth flagging

- The `Owner` entity carries its own constraints (`@NotEmpty` on firstName/lastName/address/city/telephone, and a stricter `@Pattern` requiring E.164 `^\+[0-9]{8,15}$` on telephone), but **these are never re-validated in this flow** — there's no `@Valid` at persist time and the mapper builds the entity directly. Enforcement effectively comes from the DTO constraints plus the manual controller checks.
- No password encoding, email sending, event publishing, role assignment, or `@PrePersist` timestamping occurs for owners — none of that exists in this path.
